provenance.note: Court application only (DERPF), one hearing day, populated courtCentre with lja.
provenance.operatorDescription: Makes the now-subscriptions GET fail instead of answering.
provenance.operatorRationale: ReferenceDataService.js:50-53 SWALLOWS the failure and returns null, so InformantRegisterSubscriptions/index.js:22 takes the "No Subscriptions found" exit and the pipeline emits documents with NO recipients. A reference-data outage silently produces a register nobody receives — this is the swallowed-failure class the new service exists to remove, and the Java port must be able to tell it apart from "there genuinely are no subscriptions".

operatorDetail.why: AxiosRetryWrapper.js:34 — status <= 429 is false, so it retries to exhaustion, then ReferenceDataService swallows
